::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 19th 1875  
**Manuscript:** MS Taylor Institution, Oxford
:::

My dear [Miss Freeman](people/person_524.qmd)

The first week in May will suit me very well and I hope we shall be at our best between banksia roses and nightingales.  I am afraid however that I really have only room for one and that I must not have the pleasure of having your sister though I am very sorry to be so inhospitable, but when you see our household you will understand.  I have a friend coming to me on Wednesday or Saturday, I am not sure which, but she means to stay a week, so on Saturday week I shall be quite ready, or any time after that suits you. [Miss Walter](people/person_1462.qmd) (it has no S) is mending with the Spring, but has not been out of her room since November, I hope she will soon.

yours very sincerely
C M Yonge
